Recap: SportsEngine Motion Spring Product Updates

paragraphs: SportsEngine sells technology for youth sports organizations. Products are grouped into clubs, teams, and leagues, class-based businesses and swimming, livestreaming and a program directory, tournaments and brackets, and volleyball events. Two of those product lines carry former names, GoMotion and TeamUnify for class-based businesses and Tourney Machine for tournaments.

For clubs and associations, the platform collects athlete information, waivers, and payments, runs custom reports on club finances, and confirms coach credentials. It also builds team rosters and schedules, delivers uniforms and team gear, and connects families through a club website and a mobile app. For clubs the platform also covers background checks on coaches and volunteers, athlete safety training, live streaming, fundraising with spirit wear and apparel, team sponsorships, and membership programs.

SportsEngine Motion is aimed at owners of class-based gyms and studios. That product handles class and lesson schedules, invoicing, registration, member messaging, and a website, with private lessons and bookings among the features.

quote.text: SportsEngine technology platforms include everything youth sports leaders need to grow and manage a club or association.
